# Cross-validation model comparison
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

# Paths are relative to presentation/.
o <- "../outputs"
files <- c(
  mlr_cfg   = file.path(o, "mlr/mlr_selected_config.csv"),
  mlr_fold  = file.path(o, "mlr/mlr_tuning_fold_metrics.csv"),
  mlr_class = file.path(o, "mlr/mlr_tuning_class_metrics.csv"),
  lda_fold  = file.path(o, "lda/lda_cv_fold_metrics.csv"),
  knn_best  = file.path(o, "knn/best_parameters.csv"),
  knn_fold  = file.path(o, "knn/cv_fold_metrics.csv"),
  svm_fold  = file.path(o, "models/svm/svm_rbf_selected_resample_results.csv"),
  rf_sum    = file.path(o, "random_forest/cv_summary.csv"),
  rf_fold   = file.path(o, "random_forest/cv_fold_metrics.csv"),
  baseline  = file.path(o, "random_forest/baseline_cv.csv") 
)
if (any(!file.exists(files))) {
  stop("Run the model scripts first. Missing:\n", paste(files[!file.exists(files)], collapse = "\n"))
}
r <- lapply(files, read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)

tiers   <- c("Below NQS", "Meeting NQS", "Above NQS")
recalls <- paste0("Recall_", make.names(tiers))
keep    <- c("fold", "Macro_F1", "Accuracy", recalls)

# MLR: pick the CV-selected configuration out of the tuning grid, then harmonize column names
sel <- function(d) filter(d, weights == r$mlr_cfg$weights, near(lambda, r$mlr_cfg$lambda))
mlr <- sel(r$mlr_fold) |>
  transmute(fold, Macro_F1 = macro_f1, Accuracy = accuracy) |>
  left_join(
    sel(r$mlr_class) |>
      mutate(class = paste0("Recall_", make.names(class))) |>
      select(fold, class, recall) |>
      pivot_wider(names_from = class, values_from = recall),
    by = "fold"
  )

lda <- r$lda_fold |> rename(fold = Resample)
knn <- r$knn_fold |> filter(k == r$knn_best$k, kernel == r$knn_best$kernel)
svm <- r$svm_fold |> rename(fold = Resample)
rf  <- r$rf_fold  |> filter(candidate == r$rf_sum$candidate[1])   # cv_summary is sorted best-first

cv_folds <- bind_rows(
  "MLR (Ridge)"       = select(mlr, all_of(keep)),
  "LDA"               = select(lda, all_of(keep)),
  "kNN"               = select(knn, all_of(keep)),
  "SVM (RBF)"         = select(svm, all_of(keep)),
  "Random Forest"     = select(rf,  all_of(keep)),
  "Baseline" = select(r$baseline, all_of(keep)),
  .id = "model"
)
stopifnot(all(table(cv_folds$model) == 5), !anyNA(cv_folds))

cv_summary <- cv_folds |>
  group_by(model) |>
  summarise(
    sd_f1 = sd(Macro_F1),
    across(c(Macro_F1, Accuracy, all_of(recalls)), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Macro_F1))

model_order <- cv_summary$model
models_only <- filter(cv_summary, model != "Baseline")
base_f1     <- cv_summary$Macro_F1[cv_summary$model == "Baseline"]
```

## CV results

::: {.smaller}
```{r}
#| code-fold: true
cv_summary |>
  transmute(
    Model = model,
    `Macro F1` = Macro_F1,
    `SD (Macro F1)` = sd_f1,
    Accuracy,
    `Below NQS Recall` = Recall_Below.NQS,
    `Meeting NQS Recall` = Recall_Meeting.NQS,
    `Above NQS Recall` = Recall_Above.NQS
  ) |>
  select(Model, `Macro F1`, Accuracy, `Below NQS Recall`, `Meeting NQS Recall`, `Above NQS Recall`) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, align = c("l", rep("r", 6)), format = "html")
```
:::

Values are means over the five folds.

## Macro F1 across folds

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.3
#| out-width: 90%
cv_folds |>
  mutate(model = factor(model, levels = rev(model_order))) |>
  ggplot(aes(Macro_F1, model, fill = model == "Baseline")) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "grey80", `FALSE` = "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Macro F1 (one point per fold)", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
```

## Recall by rating tier

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4.3
#| out-width: 90%
cv_summary |>
  select(model, all_of(recalls)) |>
  pivot_longer(-model, names_to = "tier", values_to = "recall") |>
  mutate(
    tier  = factor(tiers[match(tier, recalls)], levels = tiers),
    model = factor(model, levels = model_order)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(tier, recall, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.85), width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2", name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mean recall across folds") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Summary of CV comparison

- **Highest mean Macro F1:** `r models_only$model[1]` (`r sprintf("%.2f", models_only$Macro_F1[1])`), compared with `r sprintf("%.2f", base_f1)` for the majority baseline.
- **Margin over the runner-up (`r models_only$model[2]`):** `r sprintf("%.2f", models_only$Macro_F1[1] - models_only$Macro_F1[2])`, against a fold SD of about `r sprintf("%.2f", models_only$sd_f1[1])`, so the gap is `r if (models_only$Macro_F1[1] - models_only$Macro_F1[2] < models_only$sd_f1[1]) "within" else "larger than"` fold-to-fold noise.
- **Below NQS recall** ranges from `r sprintf("%.2f", min(models_only$Recall_Below.NQS))` (`r models_only$model[which.min(models_only$Recall_Below.NQS)]`) to `r sprintf("%.2f", max(models_only$Recall_Below.NQS))` (`r models_only$model[which.max(models_only$Recall_Below.NQS)]`) across the five models.
